description: This file defines the internal class ClientStreamingProviderRuntime, which implements streaming provider runtime and lifecycle participant interfaces for Orleans. It manages stream pub/sub mechanisms, stream directory, and lifecycle participation for client streaming providers.
external_methods: lifecycle.Subscribe<ClientStreamingProviderRuntime>(ServiceLifecycleStage.RuntimeInitialize, ct => Task.CompletedTask, async ct => await this.Reset(!ct.IsCancellationRequested))

classes.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
classes.description: Implements the runtime and lifecycle participant for Orleans client streaming providers, managing pub/sub, stream directory, and lifecycle events.

methods.name: ClientStreamingProviderRuntime
methods.description: Constructor initializing the runtime with dependencies and setting up pub/sub and stream directory.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the stream directory, optionally cleaning up resources.

methods.name: ExecutingEntityIdentity
methods.description: Returns the identity of the current runtime client activation.

methods.name: BindExtension
methods.description: Binds or retrieves an extension for the client context.

methods.name: PubSub
methods.description: Returns the appropriate pub/sub implementation based on the specified type.

methods.name: Participate
methods.description: Subscribes the runtime to lifecycle events for initialization and reset.

calls: lifecycle.Subscribe<ClientStreamingProviderRuntime>(ServiceLifecycleStage.RuntimeInitialize, ct => Task.CompletedTask, async ct => await this.Reset(!ct.IsCancellationRequested))
